verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a prebuilt connector for n8n, Zapier, Make or any other no-code automation platform. The webhooks, SDKs, CLI and MCP server are related integration paths, but they are not the prebuilt no-code connector the story asks for, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
